notes: userlogin.password is ignored: upstream hashes new passwords with a RANDOM 8-byte salt (SHA1Utils.entryptPassword -> SecureRandom), so the stored hash differs between runs by design. The hash's presence is still covered by the parity gate (the new account logs in with the default password). Creating 测试学生 inserts userlogin id 41 (default password hash, role 3) and student id 41 (balance 0, the explicitly filled dates 2000-01-01/2020-01-01). expected_delta.json is captured from the pristine app (never hand-written). The schema has no volatile columns (no timestamps/counters): every seeded date is fixed in the dump and the flows fill any date input explicitly, so ignore_columns is empty. All six tables are listed so the capture tooling can warn about any change outside the spec. Shiro sessions live in memory, not in the DB — there is no session table to exclude.
